title: ‘We will withdraw from agitation only after Gyanesh Kumar is removed’: K C Venugopal

ai.summary: Congress-led protests continue against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, demanding his removal and electoral system reforms, with plans for a nationwide 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' campaign to restore voting rights.

facts.claim: protests were continuing across states and districts
facts.quote: protests were continuing across states and districts, with only a brief pause expected during the Diwali festival.

facts.claim: Congress would launch a nationwide 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' campaign
facts.quote: the party would appoint a 'Vote Rakshak' (guardian) in every polling booth to scrutinise electoral rolls, identify people whose names had been deleted and visit their homes to help them get their names restored

facts.claim: Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar
facts.quote: AICC general secretary K C Venugopal on Sunday said the Congress-led agitation against CEC Gyanesh Kumar would continue until he was removed from the post and the country's electoral system was made impartial and transparent.

ai.background_note: Congress-led protests against CEC Gyanesh Kumar demand his removal and electoral system reforms, with a focus on restoring voting rights for poor citizens affected by electoral roll deletions.
